summary: This document outlines the extensive portfolio of transformative projects executed or facilitated by Professor Isa Ali Pantami in Gombe State from 2016 to 2023. Spanning his tenures as Director-General of NITDA and Minister of Communications and Digital Economy, these 242 listed initiatives positioned Gombe as the central tech hub of the North-East geopolitical zone.
